consignee_name.description: Legal consignee must match Acme Retail EU BV exactly (spacing/case ignored)

hs_code.description: HS code must be in chapter 8471 (e.g. 8471 or 8471.30)

port_of_loading.description: Port of loading must be one of the approved Asia/EU origin ports

port_of_discharge.description: Port of discharge must be an approved North Sea / Channel hub

incoterms.description: Incoterm must be an approved 2020 term (3-letter code)

description_of_goods.description: Goods description must be present and substantive

gross_weight.description: Gross weight line must include a KG unit (e.g. 1250 KG)

invoice_number.description: Commercial invoice number must be at least 4 characters
